coordinate_system.origin: PCB outline center projected onto the enclosure bottom outer face
coordinate_system.x_axis: PCB long axis; X_PLUS points right in the KiCad coordinate map
coordinate_system.y_axis: PCB short axis; Y_PLUS follows increasing KiCad Y coordinates
coordinate_system.z_axis: normal to the PCB; Z_PLUS points from the enclosure base toward the lid

critical_requirement: USB-C and sensor FFC side windows must align to their KiCad footprint centers while preserving the lid clearance above U1.
title: Environmental sensor pod board-to-enclosure release
